name: Click to Build
summary: Build shapes, paths, walls and modular structures by clicking in the viewport.

name: City Builder
summary: Draw roads, rails and junctions, place buildings that resize, and generate a whole city from a map or from a seed.

name: Perf Auditor
summary: Perf Auditor has three views in one dockable panel: Audit scans the place for problems, Live shows engine stats while you play, and Network logs remote traffic.

name: Super Aligner
summary: Select parts, models or folders, pick an axis, hover a tool to preview it as translucent ghosts, and click. Every operation lands in one undo step.

name: Terrain Tools
summary: Select parts or a whole model, pick a tool, and check the see-through preview before you apply. Green is terrain that will be added, red is terrain that will be removed. Everything is one undo step.

name: Voxelizer
summary: Pick a part, model or union, set the block size, press Generate. The result lands in place or beside the original with one undo for the lot.

name: Icon Snap
summary: Select models or folders of models, press Snap, and every model becomes a transparent PNG icon named after it. Icons can stream straight to disk, upload to Roblox, or export by hand.

name: Quick Actions
summary: A home for the small Luau snippets that are not worth a whole plugin. Save one with a name and icon, run it on your selection, or pin it to the Studio toolbar.

name: NPC Outfit Creator
summary: Build NPC outfits from Marketplace asset ids with a live rig preview. No HumanoidDescription editing by hand.
